fusions.name: Carried Ember
fusions.desc: Sends a burning locust into the first enemy it meets for 4 fire damage, setting it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Burn the Fields
fusions.desc: Sets your own swarm alight, dealing 9 fire damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Burning] for 5 seconds. The burning spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Smoke-Driven Host
fusions.desc: Increases your fire damage by 25% for 12 seconds. For 10 seconds, an escort of burning locusts fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: What the Ashes Leave
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy wears off, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
